text:
Maya (Product): Proposal: tenant-priority canary with billing guardrails. Aim is to let select paying customers test v-next while protecting infra and forecasts. Quick thumbs?

Zoe (SRE): Agree but require hard caps and automatic demotion if quotas or spend spike. Also emergency global kill only SRE can hit.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Implementation idea: `tenant_canary` flag per-tenant with fields: priority, max_daily_tokens, billing_mode (allow/prebill/hold). Router will honor quotas and emit headers.

Mei (Data): Need per-tenant quality metrics + hourly embedding-drift. We'll run targeted human evals for enrolled tenants.

Maya (Product): Rollout phases: A) invite up to 10 tenants, 80/20 baseline/v-next for 48h. B) expand to 50 tenants, 50/50 A/B, 72h. C) region-aware ramp with tenant fallback.

Oscar (Sales): Must provide Console + API for CS to enroll tenants and see a daily digest of tokens, latency, quality delta, and billing estimate. Also a customer-facing template about billing impact.

Zoe (SRE): Rollback triggers (per-tenant): error_rate > 1% OR 3x baseline; 95p latency +200ms sustained 30m; token usage > max_daily_tokens; billing spike > 40% in 1h. Action: auto-demote tenant, emit event to `canary.control`, page if >3 tenants affected.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): We'll add `X-Canary-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Canary-Token-Use` response headers and deterministic bucketing by tenant-id. Also a staging infra test that flips flags and verifies routing and headers.

Mei (Data): Suggest human-eval sample n=100 per tenant/day during Phase B and automated eval pass/fail metric per tenant.

Maya (Product): Billing guardrail behavior: if global canary spend > weekly_budget_threshold, switch new enrollments to waitlist and notify Finance; existing enrollments honor `billing_mode`.

flag-bot: Tenant enrollment requested: tenant_77 -> v-next (priority 80) id=1799990033

Carlos (Eng-Platform): I'll open PR with flag schema, quota enforcement shim, and a small simulator.

Zoe (SRE): I'll add alerting rules and lock down the global-fallback flag to SRE+ops.

Maya (Product): OK — file RFC and shiproom slot. Please comment by EOD if you need changes.

Oscar (Sales): SGTM :white_check_mark:

Mei (Data): On it, will prep eval sets.
